source_title: The 12th Google Store is opening on November 6
source_excerpt:
Following San Diego and Tokyo in 2026, the next Google Store is opening in Houston on November 6. This is the company’s 11th retail location in the US and 12th globally.
Google Store Houston Galleria opens on Friday, November 6: 5085 Westheimer Rd, Houston, TX 77056 . This indoor shopping mall has the distinction of being “ Texas’ Largest Shopping Destination .” The store hours are:
The Google Store sells Pixel phones, watches, headphones, and smart home devices, like security cameras. For those in the area, store pickups for online orders are available. The location offers on-site phone repairs, support, and other events.
Houston will be the state’s second Google Store after Austin last year.
New York : Chelsea (2021), Williamsburg (2022)
California : Mountain View (2023), Santa Monica (2025), Fashion Valley (2026)
Texas : Domain Northside (2025), Houston Galleria (2026)
